boundaries: This person-centered corpus contains Jamie's user-authorized public statements. A separate event-level heteroglossia index preserves attribution, page locators, role, stance, and turn counts for configured supportive public witnesses while leaving raw third-party testimony in the protected research layer.
Readable transcripts retain the official record's substance while correcting obvious name spellings in brackets or editorial notes; the official transcript controls.
An event listing or recollection is not a recovered verbatim transcript.
Prepared remarks do not become public testimony until delivery is established.
This inventory is complete for the testimony already identified in the governed record, not proof that no other testimony exists.
